title: FO4Edit 4.1.5f x64 (7C57FA01) scripting API: what exists, what does not

provenance.source: Tome of xEdit, section 13 Scripting Functions

provenance.note: A full core load reached Finalize at 2m15s and aborted with: [EJvInterpreterError] Error in unit 'UserScript' on line 82 : Undeclared Identifier 'GetPluginName'
background loader FINISHED at 00:11, script started, then aborted at 02:17 on AssignFile. This is the first run to prove the load path works end to end.

First report this project ever produced: 2,287,300 records, 64,926 CELL, 140 distinct signatures, verdict PASS, 1m42s. The load path and Finalize are proven end to end. This supersedes the earlier note that no report had ever been produced.

prose: Two functions this project assumed DO NOT EXIST and one it assumed was a function is a global. The absent ones are the expensive part: AddNewFileName reads like a registration call and actually creates a new plugin in the game folder and appends to the plugin list, so using it to 'activate' an existing plugin would have written to Data and mutated plugins.txt. AddElement is not a create call at all, it attaches an already-constructed element and THROWS if that element already has a container; the idempotent create is Add(container, signature, silent). GetPluginName is undeclared, confirmed both by the documented function list and by a real run. ProgramPath does exist, as a read-only global rather than a function. exists is a boolean precisely so a program can branch on it.

entries.name: Initialize
entries.behaviour: Called before the load.

entries.name: Process
entries.behaviour: Called once per record.

entries.name: Finalize
entries.behaviour: Called after the load. This is where the GetPluginName abort occurred.

entries.name: SetElementEditValues
entries.signature: SetElementEditValues(aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string; asValue: string)

entries.name: AddMessage
entries.behaviour: Writes to the xEdit console, which is why stdout must be captured.

entries.name: Add
entries.signature: Add(aeContainer: IwbContainer; asNameOrSignature: string; abSilent: boolean): IwbElement
entries.behaviour: Creates the child if absent, otherwise marks the existing child modified. This is the idempotent create.

entries.name: AddElement
entries.behaviour: Attaches an existing element. THROWS if that element already has a container. Not a create call.

entries.name: AddNewFileName
entries.signature: AddNewFileName(aeFile: IwbFile; asFileName: string; abESLFlag: boolean)
entries.behaviour: CREATES A NEW EMPTY PLUGIN in the game Data folder and appends it to the plugins list. Does not register an existing plugin. Using it that way writes to the game folder and mutates plugins.txt.
entries.caution_note: Creates a new empty plugin in the game Data folder and appends to the plugins list. A warning, not an error: the call is legitimate when a patch really is being created, which is what the upstream xEditScripts do. It is a mistake only when used to 'register' an existing plugin.

entries.name: AddNewFile
entries.behaviour: Same side effect as AddNewFileName: creates a new empty plugin.
entries.caution_note: Creates a new empty plugin in the game Data folder and appends to the plugins list. A warning, not an error: the call is legitimate when a patch really is being created, which is what the upstream xEditScripts do. It is a mistake only when used to 'register' an existing plugin.

entries.name: GetNewFormID
entries.behaviour: Returns a new FormID, the same way Add(..., ..., True) does.

entries.name: GroupBySignature
entries.behaviour: Returns the top-level group with that signature if present. Signature only, not label.

entries.name: FileByLoadOrder
entries.behaviour: How to reach a plugin that is already loaded, as opposed to creating one.

entries.name: FileWriteToStream
entries.signature: FileWriteToStream(aeFile: IInterface; akOutStream: TStream; abResetModified: Boolean)
entries.behaviour: MEASURED against the shipped reference, not transcribed from docs. third_party/xedit/Edit Scripts/SaveAs.pas:63 calls FileWriteToStream(aFile, fs, aReset) with THREE arguments. Passing two raises [EJvInterpreterError] Not enough parameters -- measured 2026-09-30 23:47. The first argument is IInterface (SaveAs declares PluginFile: IInterface and obtains it from GetFile(e)), NOT IwbFile. aReset is the reset-modified-status flag; SaveAs leaves it False, which preserves the modified status. Call it exactly as SaveAs does: TFileStream.Create(name, fmCreate), then FileWriteToStream inside try/finally with fs.Free.

entries.name: wbPositionToGridCell
entries.behaviour: Converts a world position to grid coordinates by dividing by 4096, the lateral length and width of a cell.

entries.name: TwbVector
provenance: referenced as a parameter type in docs 13.13
entries.behaviour: Referenced by wbPositionToGridCell, but NO DOCUMENTED CONSTRUCTOR was found. Calling wbPositionToGridCell may therefore be unreachable from script until one is identified.

entries.name: ProgramPath
entries.behaviour: The earlier belief that this was unproven was wrong; it exists. It is a global, so it is used without parentheses.

entries.name: GetPluginName
entries.behaviour: DOES NOT EXIST. Aborts the script at the first reference, after two minutes of loading, producing no output at all.

entries.name: AddNewElement
entries.behaviour: DOES NOT EXIST. The real calls are AddElement, Add and InsertElement.

entries.name: GetActivePlugin
entries.behaviour: DOES NOT EXIST. Not in any documented class.

entries.name: FileCount
entries.proof_note: Used in Initialize's loop over the load order. That loop ran to completion on 2026-09-30 20:33 and found PipMonTestFacility.esp at index 54, so this call demonstrably works on 4.1.5f x64.
entries.behaviour: Number of loaded files in the current session.

entries.name: GetFile
entries.proof_note: Documented with an unambiguous signature, and it still aborted our run. On 2026-09-30 20:11 the script ran 15s through Process and stopped with [EAbort] at the line calling GetFileName(GetFile(e)) once per record. Upstream says the parameter is an IwbElement, and a Process record is an IInterface; whatever the mismatch is, the signature did not predict it.
entries.behaviour: Returns the file that contains the element. PER-RECORD CALL IS NOT SAFE IN OUR USE -- see proof_note. Do not put this in a loop over every record until it is proven in isolation.
entries.caution_note: Not wrong, but not proven in a per-record loop. A warning rather than an error because it is the documented way to attribute a record to a file and is probably fine once proven on its own.

entries.name: MasterCount
entries.behaviour: Number of master files the given file has.

entries.name: MasterByIndex
entries.behaviour: Returns the aiIndex-th master file for aeFile.

detection_note: exists false means the name does not exist and any use is an error. Entries with caution true exist but have a side effect that is easy to intend wrongly, so the gate warns rather than fails. The distinction matters: a gate that fails on legitimate use teaches people to bypass it.

falsified_assumptions.assumption: AssignFile, Rewrite, WriteLn and CloseFile are standard Pascal and need no verification
falsified_assumptions.reality: NOT AVAILABLE in xEdit pascal. A real run on 2026-09-30 aborted at 02:17 with [EJvInterpreterError] Undeclared Identifier AssignFile, after the background loader completed and the script started.
falsified_assumptions.cost: two full three-minute loads to discover
falsified_assumptions.correction: write files with TStringList.SaveToFile. The report format is line oriented rather than JSON, because JSON escaping would need StringReplace, and the value of a report is not worth the risk of a malformed one.
provenance: the run log pasted by the user, 2026-09-30

falsified_assumptions.assumption: A documented upstream signature is enough to call an xEdit function in a per-record loop
falsified_assumptions.reality: GetFile(aeElement: IwbElement): IwbFile is documented, unambiguous, and aborted our Process after 15 seconds over 2.28M records. The abort is at the CALL, not at a compile check, so nothing warns you in advance.
falsified_assumptions.cost: one full three-minute load, twice: once to find the abort, once to confirm the fix
falsified_assumptions.correction: Prefer a call proven by execution in this script. Where a documented call is genuinely needed, add it to Initialize first -- Initialize runs once, so a failure there costs the run immediately and says so, instead of aborting 15s into a hot loop.

proof_vocabulary.proven_by_execution: Observed working in OUR script on THIS xEdit build. The strongest evidence there is, and the only kind that survives a game update.
proof_vocabulary.documented: Transcribed from upstream docs with a signature. Necessary and NOT sufficient: see GetFile.
proof_vocabulary.falsified_here: Documented upstream, but observed to ABORT in our use. Being documented is not a clearance.
proof_vocabulary.unproven: No evidence either way. Not a clearance and not a condemnation; it means nobody has run it.

interpreter_standard_library.note: JvInterpreter wraps whatever xEdit was compiled with, so these arrive WITHOUT a uses clause. They are not xEdit API, which is why they are recorded here rather than as entries -- and an absent entry is not evidence of absence.
provided: TStringList (Create, Add, Count, IndexOf, SaveToFile, Free)
interpreter_standard_library.proof_note: All of the above ran in our validator on 2026-09-30 20:33 over 2,287,300 records. StrToInt and IndexOf were on the hot path, so they are exercised far harder than a single call would prove.
interpreter_standard_library.not_plain_pascal: AssignFile, Rewrite, WriteLn and CloseFile are ordinary Delphi and are NOT available. See falsified_assumptions.

dialect_rules.name: no chained comparisons in a condition
dialect_rules.prohibition: Two or more string comparisons joined by and/or in one condition raise [EJvInterpreterError] Type mismatch.
dialect_rules.measured: 2026-09-30 22:41, gen_facility.gen.pas line 213: \lse if sig <> 'GRUP' and sig <> 'MAST' and sig <> 'TES4' then\ raised Type mismatch on the first Process call, after a clean Initialize that located PipMonTestFacility.esp at index 54.
dialect_rules.why_it_matters: Every static gate in this project passed that file first. check_item.py and artifact_gate.py only detect calls marked exists:false, so a file that cannot COMPILE read as clean. The compiler is the only thing that catches this, and it costs a two-minute xEdit run.
dialect_rules.instead: Use an if/else-if cascade, one comparison per condition, exactly as testfacility/xedit/validate_plugin.pas does. That file is the only one of the two with a passing run behind it.
